name: WebView HTML/JS built by string interpolation (loadHTMLString / evaluateJavaScript)
task_triggers: injecting data into a WKWebView or UIWebView
building HTML or JavaScript strings at runtime
attack_scenario: An attacker supplies a value containing <script> or a breakout like '); maliciousCode(); //; the WebView executes it in the app's origin, letting the attacker read the DOM, call exposed native bridges, and exfiltrate session data or local files.
negative_test_hint: supply a comment containing "'); alert(document.cookie); //" and assert the WebView does not execute it, because data crosses the bridge as JSON rather than interpolated code

exemplar.explanation: Interpolating untrusted values into an HTML or JavaScript string with stringWithFormat/stringByAppendingString and handing it to a WebView is DOM-based XSS (OWASP MSTG-PLATFORM-2, CWE-79). The injected script runs in the app's origin, where it can read the DOM, call exposed native bridges, and exfiltrate session data or local files; loading static templates and passing data across the JS bridge as JSON keeps user input out of executable code.
